gloss: sleeping with one's head to the north

definitions.gloss: sleeping with one's head to the north
definitions.explanation: Lying or sleeping with the head pointing north. Traditionally avoided because the dead are laid out this way, following the posture of the Buddha at his death.

examples.japanese: {北枕|きたまくら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Sleeping with your head to the north is said to be bad luck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{北枕|きたまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}ない→寝る：00470_neru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother told me not to sleep with my head to the north.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{北枕|きたまくら}になっていた。
examples.english: The bed in the hotel room had its head to the north.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北枕|きたまくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: These days many young people don't worry about sleeping facing north.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A body is laid with its head to the north before a Buddhist funeral, because the Buddha is said to have died lying with his head to the north, facing west. Sleeping that way is therefore traditionally avoided as unlucky (⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧). Many people today ignore the taboo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北枕|きたまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep with one's head to the north
- {北枕|きたまくら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lay (a body, a bed) with the head to the north
- {北枕|きたまくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid sleeping facing north
